prose: Microsoft AI releases MAI-Code-1.1-Flash, now in production in GitHub Copilot, at one quarter of the price of version 1.0. It reports a 22% improvement on Terminal-Bench 2.1 in Copilot CLI and 15% on .NET tasks, with code survival up 4% and return visits up 9%.
Tokens stream 25% faster and tasks use 25% fewer tokens. Microsoft credits training across hundreds of thousands of reinforcement-learning environments in Copilot. All figures are Microsoft's own.
highlights: MAI-Code-1.1-Flash in GitHub Copilot at one quarter of 1.0's price
Terminal-Bench 2.1 up 22% in Copilot CLI, .NET tasks up 15%
Code survival up 4%, return visits up 9%
